svg.title: Lunch timecard: 510 elapsed minutes, 30 meal minutes, two conditional totals
svg.desc: 08:30 to 12:00 gives 210 minutes. Lunch 12:00 to 12:30 gives 30. 12:30 to 17:00 gives 270. Excluding the meal gives 480 minutes or 8.00 hours; including it gives 510 minutes or 8.50 hours. Confirm treatment before deducting.

g.text: Illustrated clock times — not your employee record
A meal label or duration does not authorize a deduction.
Unresolved duties or applicable rules → pending confirmation.
Clock-minute arithmetic · assumes no daylight-saving clock change
